description: The page where the person completes the swap, with the amount prefilled. A swap for a person is completed by that person on the page: open the link, check the amount, both addresses and the memo on screen, then send the deposit from your own wallet. An agent that controls the sending wallet itself uses create_swap and pays the instruction it gets back.

mode.description: private: the page opens with Private mode switched on

via.description: with mode=private: xmr opens the page with Untraceable mode switched on (the hop runs on Monero)

name: swap_page_link
title: Swap page link (hand-off)
